references.text: The children of Reuben and Gad wished to settle in Gilead, which is the background for the conflict in Joshua 22
Moses gave the land on the east side of the Jordan to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh, including Gilead
Moses describes how he gave Gilead to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half of Manasseh
Describes that Reuben and Gad received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses had given them
The context for this event - the eastern tribes returned to Gilead
Phinehas and the leaders were sent as a delegation to the eastern tribes
Phinehas' earlier zeal for the Lord, explaining why he was chosen for this task
